title: transport: fix data race on `bdpEstimator.sentAt`.
body:
In `bdpEstimator`, the `timesnap` method updates `b.sentAt = time.Now()` without acquiring `b.mu`. However, `b.sentAt` is:
- Read under `b.mu` in `calculate()` (`time.Since(b.sentAt)`)
- Reset under `b.mu` in `add()` (`b.sentAt = time.Time{}`)
Because `timesnap()` is executed by the writer goroutine (`loopyWriter`) while `calculate()` and `add()` are executed by the reader goroutine, this constitutes a data race on `b.sentAt` (a 24-byte `time.Time` struct) under concurrent access (e.g. unsolicited/delayed PING ACKs).
### Solution
- Acquire `b.mu` before assigning `b.sentAt` in `timesnap()`.

RELEASE NOTES: N/A
